interpretation.text: Hierarchical clustering (Ward linkage, euclidean distance) of 50 cases was cut into 4 clusters of sizes 7, 12, 19, 12. The agglomerative coefficient was 0.93, and the average silhouette width of 0.34 indicates a weak cluster structure.

title: Hierarchical Clustering
code:
library(ggnext)
# Hierarchical clustering (ward.D2 linkage, euclidean distance), cut into 4 clusters
vars <- c("murder", "assault", "urban_pop", "rape")
d <- data[complete.cases(data[, vars, drop = FALSE]), , drop = FALSE]
x <- scale(d[vars])   # z-scores, so every variable counts equally
rownames(x) <- make.unique(as.character(d$state))
hc <- hclust(dist(x, method = "euclidean"), method = "ward.D2")
cluster <- factor(cutree(hc, k = 4))
sizes <- data.frame(cluster = levels(cluster), n = as.vector(table(cluster)))
centers <- aggregate(d[vars], list(cluster = cluster), mean)
sil <- cluster::silhouette(as.integer(cluster), dist(x))
silhouette_avg <- mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
sizes$silhouette <- as.vector(tapply(sil[, "sil_width"], cluster, mean))
agglomerative_coef <- cluster::coef.hclust(hc)
# Dendrogram segments from the merge history
n <- length(hc$order)
leaf_x <- match(seq_len(n), hc$order)
node_x <- numeric(n - 1)
segs <- vector("list", n - 1)
for (i in seq_len(n - 1)) {
  child <- hc$merge[i, ]
  cx <- ifelse(child < 0, leaf_x[abs(child)], node_x[abs(child)])
  cy <- ifelse(child < 0, 0, hc$height[abs(child)])
  node_x[i] <- mean(cx)
  segs[[i]] <- data.frame(x = c(cx[1], cx[2], cx[1]), xend = c(cx[1], cx[2], cx[2]), y = c(cy[1], cy[2], hc$height[i]), yend = hc$height[i])
}
dendro <- do.call(rbind, segs)
cut_height <- mean(rev(hc$height)[c(3, 4)])   # height that gives 4 clusters
p_dendrogram <- ggnext(dendro, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend)) +
  geom_segment() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = cut_height, dash = "4 4") +
  labs(title = "Dendrogram", x = "Cases", y = "Height") +
  theme_modern()
pc <- prcomp(x)
plot_df <- data.frame(PC1 = pc$x[, 1], PC2 = pc$x[, 2], cluster = cluster)
pc_var <- round(100 * pc$sdev^2 / sum(pc$sdev^2), 1)
p_clusters <- ggnext(plot_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Clusters on the first two principal components") +
  theme_modern()
p_clusters <- p_clusters + labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", pc_var[1], "%)"), y = paste0("PC2 (", pc_var[2], "%)"))
